title: %hmac — keyed hash (HMAC)
purpose: Compute a hex HMAC of a message under a secret key; algorithm defaults to sha256.
notes: The digest is lowercase hex. The default algorithm is sha256; pass a third argument (e.g. "sha1", "sha512") to change it.
The same message and key always produce the same digest.

avoid.why: the key is required; with one argument the result is ~
